messages:
alex: hey! just finished initial setup for my MBP (M2, company image). Kandji shows the machine as enrolled but the 'Local Admin' profile is stuck in Pending and i can't sudo or install homebrew. getting: \"sudo: user alex is not in the sudoers file\". also my SSH public key didn't make it onto the device for git pushes and the corp wifi cert is missing so zscaler vpn fails. who should i ping for a quick temp admin?

itops-jordan: welcome! can you paste the serial (apple menu > About) and a screenshot of Kandji showing Pending? we can push a local-admin script but need to confirm device and consent window. for ssh key we can either push as a profile or you can paste your public key here and we add it to your device record.

alex: serial C02ZQ0XYZ0G7, Kandji page screenshot uploaded to this thread. public key: ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAI... alex@personal-laptop

emily-mdm: looked up the device id. Policy is Pending because our Apple DEP token had a brief hitch last night — some newly enrolled devices land in Pending until we re-sync. i'm going to re-trigger the MDM sync and reapply the Local Admin payload now. ETA ~10-20m. i'll also escrow FileVault key once it's verified.

alex: awesome, thanks. quick question: running `fdesetup status` returns:
```
FileVault is On.
Encryption Type: AES-XTS
```
but Kandji shows \"No FV escrow\" — is that normal?

emily-mdm: if it says FileVault is On locally but not escrowed, we need to run the escrow script from Kandji. i'll push that as well. once you see the \"FileVault key escrowed\" notice in Kandji you can ignore the warning. i'll DM you when it's done and push the local admin script so you can install brew.

sam: fyi for installing dev certs once you have admin: you can import the corp wifi cert with:
```
sudo security import /path/to/corp.p12 -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain -P <password> -T /usr/bin/security
```
and for SSH key placement if we push via profile it lands at `/Users/alex/.ssh/authorized_keys` with correct perms. if you need immediate git access we can also add the pubkey to the git org on your account.

itops-jordan: emily triggered the sync and I also queued a job to add alex as a local_admin group for 2 hours. mdm-bot will post the deployment status here.

mdm-bot: Deployment started: push_local_admin_7852 -> device_id=DD-9F-3A
mdm-bot: Deployment completed: push_local_admin_7852 -> success (user added to /etc/sudoers.d/company-temp-admins)

alex: i can sudo now, brew installed fine. filevault escrow shows up in Kandji too. thanks everyone :tada:

emily-mdm: great — leaving the temp admin for 2 hours as discussed. when you're done reply here and we'll remove it. also filing a quick follow-up ticket to renewable DEP token so fewer Pending enrolls.

alex: removed test packages, all good. you can revoke the temp admin. thanks again! :raised_hands:
